_comment: Single source of truth for the site's page list. Read by extract-pulled.py,
deploy.sh, verify.sh and prerender.py via manifest.py — do NOT re-hardcode a
page list in any of them.
Adding a page: add ONE entry here, then add its URL to sitemap.xml and a line
to llms.txt. verify.sh gate (i) fails until those two match this file.
role: home    -> the Design home; deployed as index.html (generated artifact)
content  -> a real page: gets static SEO head, pre-render, sitemap, llms.txt
stub     -> redirect-only page: no pre-render, no sitemap, no llms.txt entry
variant  -> generated at deploy from another page (none yet: EN/FR is an in-page toggle)

slugs are the legacy Wix URLs (/about /book /speaking /more /blog /contact): they match the canonicals Design already ships and keep old links alive at cutover. slug-links.py renames the Design file and rewrites internal links accordingly.
_draft_note: Draft phase: served from the github.io preview with NO custom domain. www.delbourg-delphis.org is Marylene's LIVE Wix site: a CNAME file here would hijack it. While true: no CNAME, every page is noindex. Set to false + restore CNAME only when Gregory and Marylene decide to cut the domain over.
